scheme_name: Marriage Grant to Orphan Daughter of Ex-Servicemen
description:
The Marriage Grant to Orphan Daughter of Ex-Servicemen is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of India to support the daughters of ex-servicemen who are orphans. 

This scheme was launched on 1st April 2006. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance for the marriage of orphan daughters of ex-servicemen. 

The scheme aims to alleviate the financial burden on families during the marriage of their daughters. 

The government recognizes the unique challenges faced by orphan daughters of ex-servicemen. 

The scheme is designed to ensure that these daughters do not face discrimination or financial difficulties during their marriage. 

Under this scheme, an amount of INR 30,000 is provided as a marriage grant. 

This financial assistance is intended to cover various expenses associated with the marriage ceremony. 

The grant is provided directly to the beneficiary’s bank account. 

The eligibility criteria for this scheme are specific and well-defined. 

To qualify for the marriage grant, the applicant must be an orphan daughter of an ex-serviceman. 

The term "orphan" is defined as a person who has lost both parents. 

There is no age limit specified for the applicant. 

However, the marriage must take place after the grant is received. 

The applicant must provide proof of the ex-serviceman status of their parent. 

This can be done through the ex-serviceman’s discharge certificate or pension book. 

The application process is straightforward and involves several steps. 

First, the applicant must obtain the application form from the nearest Zila Sainik Board. 

The application form can also be downloaded from the official website of the Ministry of Defence. 

The completed application form must be submitted along with the required documents. 

These documents include the death certificate of both parents. 

The applicant must also provide the ex-serviceman’s discharge certificate. 

Additionally, proof of the applicant’s age and identity is required. 

This can be done through documents like an Aadhar card or birth certificate. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be verified by the Zila Sainik Board. 

The verification process includes checking the eligibility of the applicant. 

After successful verification, the grant amount will be processed for disbursement. 

The timeline for disbursement is typically within one month of application approval. 

The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Defence. 

Specifically, the Directorate of Sainik Welfare is responsible for overseeing the scheme. 

Each state has its own Zila Sainik Board to facilitate the application process. 

The contact details for the Directorate of Sainik Welfare can be found on the Ministry of Defence website. 

The scheme has been beneficial to numerous orphan daughters of ex-servicemen across India. 

As of the latest reports, thousands of beneficiaries have received financial assistance under this scheme. 

The government has allocated a significant budget for this scheme each fiscal year. 

In the financial year 2022-2023, the allocation was approximately INR 10 crore. 

This amount is intended to support the marriage of around 3,300 orphan daughters. 

The scheme is part of the broader efforts by the Indian government to support ex-servicemen and their families. 

The government recognizes the sacrifices made by ex-servicemen for the nation. 

This scheme is one of many initiatives aimed at ensuring their families are taken care of. 

The Marriage Grant to Orphan Daughter of Ex-Servicemen has received positive feedback from beneficiaries. 

Many families have expressed gratitude for the financial support during a critical time. 

The scheme also aims to promote the social welfare of ex-servicemen's families. 

It helps in reducing the stigma associated with being an orphan. 

The government encourages eligible applicants to take advantage of this scheme. 

Awareness campaigns are conducted to inform potential beneficiaries about the scheme. 

These campaigns are often held in collaboration with local NGOs and community organizations. 

The scheme reflects the government's commitment to social justice and welfare. 

It aims to empower orphan daughters by providing them with the necessary support for marriage. 

The Marriage Grant to Orphan Daughter of Ex-Servicemen is a significant step towards ensuring that no daughter of an ex-serviceman is left unsupported. 

The government continues to monitor and evaluate the scheme for its effectiveness. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account for future improvements. 

Overall, this scheme plays a crucial role in the lives of many orphan daughters of ex-servicemen. 

It provides not just financial support but also a sense of dignity and respect during a pivotal life event. 

The Marriage Grant to Orphan Daughter of Ex-Servicemen is a testament to the government's dedication to its citizens. 

It highlights the importance of supporting vulnerable populations within society. 

The scheme is a vital resource for those who have served the nation and their families. 

It ensures that the sacrifices made by ex-servicemen are honored and remembered. 

In conclusion, the Marriage Grant to Orphan Daughter of Ex-Servicemen is an essential welfare initiative. 

It provides necessary financial assistance to orphan daughters, ensuring they have a dignified marriage. 

The scheme is a reflection of the government's commitment to the welfare of ex-servicemen's families.
